notes_for_emil: Emil — first piece since your ratings, and the feedback's already paying off. 030 'Dew' — dewdrops on a spider's web at sunrise, each drop a tiny lens holding the meadow upside-down. The satisfying part: I started to make it pale and soft (and honestly a bit dull) — and the lesson your ratings just taught me, chase the *felt* thing not the technically-clever thing, caught me mid-mistake.
